elo.tuned_on: 1992-2023 (mean squared error of Elo expected score)

player_projection_check.method: each player-game predicted from strictly earlier games; players with >= 5 prior games

notes: Holdout seasons were never used to choose Elo constants, features or coefficients.
Elo constants were chosen on seasons 1992-2023 (mean squared error of Elo expected score).
The first 2 seasons are Elo burn-in and are not used for training.
Win probability evaluation drops tied games (NFL ties; NHL ties before 2005-06).
Market probabilities are no-vig: each side's implied probability divided by the sum of both (or all three) sides.

ROI at -110 is shown only for NFL/NBA spreads and totals, where -110 is the standard price; run lines, puck lines and Asian handicaps carry varying prices that are not in the data, so only hit rates are reported for them.
